name: living-resume
description: Never update your résumé again. Turn your LinkedIn or old résumé into a current résumé (PDF, Word, web page) and keep it updated. Say "add this to my résumé" and it decides what belongs, makes a true version for each kind of job, finds the jobs that fit you best every week, and walks you through LinkedIn. Works in Claude and ChatGPT. No coding needed; your data stays on your computer.
